name: skillsync
description: SkillSync: a MERN job platform with job seeker, company, recruiter and admin portals

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
